name: Solene Anglaret
subject: back in dubai, straight to the theatre

beats.hook: Back in Dubai for a few days, straight to the theatre, an Intensive with Kyle Herselman at the Courtyard Playhouse. Still paying to be the student.
beats.identity: Choosing who gets your time is my job. Last few coaches had a first meeting inside 10 days.
beats.offer: I went and found 10 names already. People here who'd be worth the meeting.
beats.cta: Give me 15 minutes this week and the 10 are in your inbox before the call ends, plus what ruled the other 40 out.
beats.ps: ps: a no costs you nothing, and beats a maybe.
